leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement ternary operators to conditionally render JSX elements based on boolean values
Apply conditional logic to control the display of different components within a React application
Construct inline conditional expressions that render alternative content based on state variables
Configure component rendering behavior by evaluating props through ternary conditions
Manipulate UI visibility by combining multiple ternary operators for complex conditional scenarios
Initialize conditional rendering patterns that respond to user interactions and state changes
Integrate ternary expressions with event handlers to update displayed content dynamically
